body:
This was actually wrong. I changed it to have integrity as part of the map.
The problem with integrity, is that if there is a mismatch in integrity, you can't tell if the preload is usable until the entire response is loaded.

Researching this I believe it would have been better to not have integrity matching on preloads at all, and leave it to the actual resource to integrity-match.

Note also that the behavior is not intuitive in cases where the consuming resource cannot specify metadata integrity, e.g. CSS images. If the preload fails integrity, should CSS tries to re-fetch, or consume the null body?
